svg.title: ARIA System Architecture — Proactive AI Personal Assistant
svg.desc: Full system architecture diagram for ARIA, a proactive AI assistant covering data ingestion, behavior modeling, context fusion, urgency engine, and action surfaces.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What data sources does ARIA ingest?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA read notes and tasks?')
sendPrompt('What behavioral signals does ARIA capture?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA use email and messages?')
sendPrompt('What ambient signals does ARIA use?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA capture explicit inputs?')
sendPrompt('How does the ingestion and normalization layer work?')
g.text: Connectors, dedup, unified event stream, privacy filter, on-device embedding

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ARIA store and retrieve memory?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA build semantic memory?')
sendPrompt('What is procedural memory in ARIA?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIAs behavior model learn user patterns?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA model transitions between activities?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA detect anomalies in behavior?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA fuse all context signals?')
g.text: Merges: current time + calendar slots + behavioral prediction + workload state + ambient signals

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ARIA calculate urgency scores?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA decide when to interrupt the user?')
g.text: Is user in flow? Cost of interrupt?

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ARIA generate proactive suggestions?')
sendPrompt('What is a glanceable ambient card?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA send proactive nudges?')
sendPrompt('When does ARIA show a rich action card?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA do background automation?')
sendPrompt('How does ARIA learn from user feedback?')
g.text: Tracks accepted/dismissed/ignored suggestions → re-weights urgency model continuously

svg.text: All behavior data processed on-device · No raw content leaves the device · User controls memory scope per source
